intent: Dense low-profile gravel beds on exposed rock, mostly 1-3 cm across with occasional 4-7 cm pebbles and rare flat chips up to 10 cm; entirely cosmetic
placement: Deterministic clustered fields from shared rock surface data. Vary core density and edge shape; reject snow/grass and implausible steep faces. Seat along terrain normals, avoid overlapping/stacked silhouettes, and fill gaps with smaller stones.
performance_boundary: Densities are starting points for appearance, not approved runtime budgets. Use bounded batches and residency; measure dense and sparse modes independently and preserve the gravel-bed appearance when choosing a representation.

cosmetic_size_limits.placement: Keep runtime widths within 1-10 cm. Use source dimensions at scale 1 by default; any variation must enforce the final width and exposed-height limits. Seat and partially bury along the local terrain normal, never stack cosmetic stones. Larger 5-10 cm accents must read as shallow embedded gravel, not obstacles.
